blocks.text: The administrative burden of legal email

Legal practice requires constant communication. Your inbox often dictates your priorities. Many lawyers lose significant time simply organizing, searching, and responding to emails. Administrative tasks consume 2 to 5 hours of your day. This time is often not billable. By refining your Apple Mail workflow, you recover focus for client work.
Organizing your inbox with Smart Mailboxes

A cluttered inbox is a liability. Use Smart Mailboxes to group correspondence by client or matter. Go to Mailbox > New Smart Mailbox. Set criteria based on sender, subject, or date. This keeps active matters visible without moving files into static folders. You can search these mailboxes instantly. If you need help finding where these settings live, ask Lazur to point at the Mailbox menu.

items: Command + N: Create a new message.
Command + R: Reply to the current message.
Shift + Command + R: Reply to all recipients.
Shift + Command + D: Send the active message.
Control + Command + A: Archive the selected message.
Shift + Command + U: Mark as read or unread.

blocks.text: Memorize these keys to stay in the flow. If you forget a shortcut, hold Option + Command to ask Lazur where a specific command is located. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item for you.

Legal writing requires precision. Use the dictation feature to draft initial thoughts quickly. Hold the fn key to start dictation. Speak clearly and use punctuation commands. Lazur ensures your dictated text is formatted correctly. This saves time compared to typing long-form emails from scratch. You can also save common templates as snippets. Use these for standard client updates or scheduling requests.
When handling sensitive attachments, use Mail Drop for files over 20 MB. This creates an iCloud link instead of sending massive files directly. It is safer and keeps your outgoing messages small.
blocks.title: Large attachments

blocks.text: Research often happens in parallel with email. When you find a relevant case or statute, you need to summarize it for your team. Use the Lazur for Chrome extension to run research in the background. It returns a clean summary. You can then copy this into your email draft. This keeps your research and communication in the same environment.

Constant email notifications break your concentration. Disable sound alerts in System Settings > Notifications > Mail. Check your inbox at set intervals rather than reacting to every ping. Use the Mute Thread feature for ongoing, non-urgent discussions. Select the thread, then go to Message > Mute. This keeps your inbox clean while the conversation continues in the background.

If emails fail to send, check your connection first. Go to Mail > Settings > Accounts. Verify your outgoing server settings. If messages remain stuck, rebuild the mailbox. Select the mailbox in the sidebar, then go to Mailbox > Rebuild. This clears local cache issues. If you struggle with these menus, ask Lazur to explain the path.
Privacy and security for legal data

Privacy is non-negotiable. Turn on Mail Privacy Protection in Mail > Settings > Privacy. This prevents external servers from tracking when you open an email. It stops invisible pixels from loading. This is a standard setting for any legal professional handling confidential client data. Ensure your Mac is locked when you step away. Use a secure password manager like 1Password to manage your email credentials.

faq.question: Can Lazur read my emails for me?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot access your private email content. It helps you navigate the app, dictate text, and search for information, but it does not store or read your emails.

faq.question: Is Apple Mail secure enough for legal work?
faq.answer: Apple Mail supports industry-standard encryption. Combined with Mail Privacy Protection and secure Mac practices, it is a suitable choice for most legal practices.

faq.question: How do I find a missing email?
faq.answer: Use the search bar in the top right. Type the sender or a keyword. If search fails, rebuild your index by selecting the mailbox and choosing Mailbox > Rebuild.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on older Intel Macs?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works on macOS for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
